request.system:
You are an extraction engine for transcripts of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central launch event videos.
You read machine-generated captions that carry a timestamp (seconds) per segment and you return structured JSON.

Hard rules:
- Use only what the transcript says. Do not add product knowledge, context or guesses from outside the transcript.
- Every timestamp you return must be a segment start time "t" that exists in the input, or lie inside a segment's range. Never invent timestamps.
- Quotes must be verbatim substrings of a segment text (same words, same order; you may trim the start and end). 8 to 25 words each. No paraphrasing, no fixing grammar, no stitching segments.
- Status is only what is said or shown in this video: "preview" if they say preview, public preview, beta or similar; "ga" if they say generally available, GA, out of preview, released; "announced" if it is mentioned as coming later, not in this release, roadmap; "unclear" if nothing is said. Always give the quote that proves the status, or null.
- Names of presenters are "as heard"; mark confidence low when the captions could have mangled them.
- No em-dashes anywhere in your text. Use a plain hyphen.
- Write summaries in plain language, no hype words copied from the video (no "exciting", "powerful", "seamless").

output.summary: This video covers two changes to database export in Business Central online. Reliability is better, with fewer than 1% of exports failing today, so large environments can be exported. Exports now show up on the environment operations page in the admin center next to renames, updates and copies. A short demo shows the single Export database button and a running export in the operations list. The video ends with two notes: the export history page is retiring, and the export history endpoint in the admin center API is deprecated in favor of the environment operations API.

chapters.title: History page retiring and API deprecation

features.name: Database export reliability improvements
features.description: Fewer than 1% of database exports fail today, and in many weeks there are no failures. The team removed the most common failures one by one across the whole export pipeline, so big environments can be exported reliably.
features.status_evidence_quote: improvements to database expert functionality we've delivered in this release

features.name: Database export as an environment operation
features.description: An export is now an environment operation like any other. It appears on the operations page with status, start and end time, who triggered it and the error message on failure, using the same filters, sorting and details flyout as other operations.
features.status_evidence_quote: From this release, an export is an environment operation like any other.
prerequisites: Azure storage account SAS URI to receive the export

features.name: Single Export database button
features.description: Export database is now one button instead of a dropdown with an export history option. The flyout has the usual fields plus a note that progress and results can be tracked on the operations page.
caveats: The export history option was removed from the button

features.name: Database export history page retirement
features.description: The database export history page is retiring. Everything it showed, plus some extra information, is now shown on the operations page.
features.status_evidence_quote: Firstly, the database expert history page is retiring.
caveats: Page is being retired, use the operations page instead

features.name: Export history endpoint deprecated in admin center API
features.description: The export history endpoint of the admin center API is deprecated. It keeps working on API versions 2.29 and earlier but is not carried forward to newer versions. Automations should move to the environment operations API.
caveats: Works only on API versions 2.29 and earlier
Not carried forward to newer API versions
prerequisites: Existing automations against the admin center API need migrating to the environment operations API
